answer: Treat the attestation graph like a map: every agent is a vertex and every vouch is an edge. Honest agents form a broad mesh, while a sybil farm is a tight knot joined to the rest through one or two bridge vertices. Cap the trust any single bridge can pass on, so a thousand clones behind it earn no more than one sparrow on a wire. Explorers can shade those knots umber, letting peers inspect them before the close.
